title: QM Bench validation datasets for quality engineering calculations
description: Input datasets and reference results used to validate the free quality engineering tools at https://qmbench.com: process capability (Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk), X-bar R and I-MR control limits, Gage R&R (ANOVA and average and range), type 1 gauge study, linearity and bias, p and u charts, ISO 2859-1 AQL sampling plans and OC curve, and linear regression. Reference values from SciPy/NumPy or published AIAG and ISO tables.
